english.title: Cause to be produced a false copy of an entry in the trademarks register
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused to be produced or tendered in evidence a thing falsely purporting to be a copy of an entry in the register of trade marks, namely **(..DESCRIBE THE ENTRY..), knowing or believing that it was false
english.legislation: Contrary to section 94(2)(b) and (3) of the Trade Marks Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause to produce/tender in evidence falsely purporting copy of entry register of trade marks
knowing/believing that it was false

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Achosi i gopi anwir o gofnod yn y gofrestr nodau masnach gael ei gyflwyno
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) bu i chi achosi i rywbeth gael ei ddarparu neu ei gyflwyno mewn tystiolaeth, a oedd yn honni'n anwir bod yn gopi o gofnod yn y gofrestr nodau masnach, sef **(..DESCRIBE THE ENTRY..), gan wybod neu gan gredu ei fod yn anwir
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 94(2)(b) a (3) Deddf Nodau Masnach 1994.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
